definitions.explanation: To place something in an upright position. The transitive form of {立|た}つ.
To create or establish plans, rules, or abstract things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}てる。

examples.english: Stand books up on the shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}てないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.notes: {音|おと}を{立|た}てる = make a sound

examples.japanese: ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{立|た}てて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}めよう→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's set a goal before starting.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {立|た}つ (intransitive, to stand). Pattern: Xを{立|た}てる (stand X up / make X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {立|た}てている = 'has set up' or 'is standing (something).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てる (make a plan)
・{予定|よてい}を{立|た}てる (make a schedule)
・{目標|もくひょう}を{立|た}てる (set a goal)
・{音|おと}を{立|た}てる (make a sound)
・{旗|はた}を{立|た}てる (raise a flag)
・{腹|はら}を{立|た}てる (get angry)

HOMOPHONE: Don't confuse with {建|た}てる (to build), which has the same reading.
・{立|た}てる (立): to stand up, erect (general)
・{建|た}てる (建): to build (structures)

CONTRAST:
・{立|た}てる (transitive): stand X up
・{立|た}つ (intransitive): X stands
